t: Sensor Driver Integrator - public implementations survey
title: Sensor Driver Integrator - public implementations survey
definition: Connects embedded software to supported sensors.
description:
Sensor Driver Integrator is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Connects embedded software to supported sensors. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Sensor Driver Integrator. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Sensor Driver Integrator. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Sensor Driver Integrator capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Sensor Driver Int
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Sensor Driver Int

description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Sensor Driver Integrator from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Sensor Driver Integrator needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
